responseMessageContents.text:
That `sbp_…` value is a Supabase **personal access token**, not an owner-session JWT, so it cannot authenticate the IVX production deployment endpoint. Please rotate it because it was shared in chat.

I still need a current **production owner access token** beginning `eyJ…` (from an active Supabase sign-in session), added through the secure environment input as `IVX_OWNER_TOKEN`. With that, I can complete the authorized Render deployment and provide live SHA-parity evidence.
